email.subject: POAP KINGS is looking for serious Clash Royale players (3,300+ trophies)
email.body:
If you have been bouncing between clans that feel disposable, POAP KINGS is built differently.

We are an active war clan with 49 members, over 6,400 weekly donations, and players sitting above 13,000 trophies. We take Clan Wars seriously — and we recognize the people who show up for it.

Every season, the top war contributor earns a free Pass Royale. That is a real clan tradition, not a raffle. We also issue POAPs — collectible on-chain records — for seasons, milestones, and moments worth remembering. Most clans do not do that.

We use an AI system called Elixir to track war participation, donations, and player progress across the clan. It keeps us accountable and helps us recognize effort that would otherwise go unnoticed.

If you want a clan with structure, memory, and real competitive energy, come find us at poapkings.com.

reddit.body:
**POAP KINGS | #J2RGCRVG | 3,300 required trophies**

---

**Quick stats:**
- 49 members | 429,000+ combined trophies
- 6,400+ weekly donations
- Clan Wars active every week
- Top members above 13,500 trophies

---

**Who we are:**

POAP KINGS is a war-focused Clash Royale clan that takes member recognition seriously. We were founded by three players who wanted to build something with structure and identity instead of settling for clans that felt disposable. That founding energy is still here.

We run a Free Pass Royale program — every season, the top war contributor earns a free pass. Last season it went to the only player who used every war deck on every battle day. That kind of effort gets noticed here.

We also issue POAPs — collectible on-chain records — for seasons and milestones. It sounds unusual for a Clash Royale clan because it is. We use an AI operator called Elixir to track war participation, donations, and player progress so nothing gets lost.

**A few standouts:**
- Vijay is sitting at 13,710 trophies and 486 donations this week
- OllieTurtle at 13,514 trophies with a Tesla and Goblin Drill core
- Chanco leads donations at 568 this week alone

---

**What we are looking for:**
- 3,300+ trophies
- Players who participate in Clan Wars when life allows
- People who want to be part of a clan with actual memory and culture

More info at poapkings.com. Search the clan tag in-game to request.
